input.summary: Fail. (1) The checker reports a failed rule. N-R1 fails because four areas are farther than 250 m from any stop or station: docks-east 291 m, lantern-west 288 m, rocket-west 275 m and harbour-east 269 m. Vantage shows that no stop position on T1 + S1 can fix this. The lines have to change, or Aster has to change the standard or the plots. Vantage's blocking hand-off to Datum is resolved by code, so I do not raise it again. (2) Pulse's timetable notes add a flat $5 fare, but GDD §02 says travel costs time only, with no fare. All other rules pass. Interchange T1/circus to S1/circus is about 119 m (limit 150). Headways of 120 s and 90 s, dwells of 15 s and 12 s, and speeds of 8 m/s and 12 m/s are plausible starting values. The journeys cover the main trips through the only interchange. Open questions, not faults: the stop list in the plan (S1 Crown Circus at x 95, Harbour at x 340) differs from the candidate (x 90, x 290). Datum and Vantage report that the plan's notes/why still describe the old draft, and Aster should resolve that. The 1.4 m/s interchange walking pace is marked as a placeholder and is rightly sent to Motive with the other boarding questions.

faults.fault: Four areas are beyond the 250 m transit reach of every tram stop and sky rail station: docks-east 291 m, lantern-west 288 m, rocket-west 275 m and harbour-east 269 m. With T1 on the Boulevard and S1 on the z 0 trunk, no stop position can bring these corner areas within reach.
faults.fix: Add or move a line so it passes near x ±260 (Sunset Way / Harbour Road side), for example an east-side tram once the road plan allows a terminal loop. Otherwise escalate to Aster to change the reach standard or the plots. Then rerun the plan checker.

faults.fault: A timetable note says boarding costs 'a flat $5 fare per ride, charged at the gate, plus the wait.' GDD §02 says the price is time only (the wait plus the ride) and that there is no fare. This is an invented price that contradicts the GDD.
faults.fix: Remove the fare note. Price boarding in time only (wait plus ride from the timetable). Send any fare idea to Motive as an open question, not as a rule.
